alex: Heads-up — nightly perf on paged-attn showed a regression when KV paging is enabled. Fused Flash variant (fused-flash-v3) is ~25% slower on long sequences (>4096) compared to last week. attaching quick profile snippet below.

perf-ci-bot: [auto] nightly-run 2026-03-17: model=redwood-flash-large seq=8192 batch=1 kv_pager=on -> status=regressed

alex: Micro numbers from local repro (seq=8192, batch=1, page_size=64, kv_pager=on):
```
fused-flash-v3: 160.2 ms/token (was 124.5)
flash2-cpu-opt: 138.7 ms/token (was 140.1)
flash-attn-legacy: 172.4 ms/token (unchanged)
```

maya: Ugh. Do we know whether the hotspot is allocation or kernel compute?

alex: Profile shows long pauses in "kv_pager::page_alloc" and "block_table::scan_and_pin" around kernel launch. There's also a tail of small CUDA memcpy spikes right before fused kernel starts — looks like fragmentation + prefetch ordering issue.

zara: Can you paste the command you ran? I want to run smaller loop.

alex: `./bench/run --model=flash-large --engine=paged-attn --seq=8192 --batch=1 --page-size=64 --kv-pager=on --iters=200 --kernels=fused-flash-v3,flash2`

alex: Also dumping allocator stats at end of each iter showed many tiny free slabs:
```
total_slabs=1024 used_slabs=978 free_slabs=46 slab_frag_pct=31.2
avg_free_chunk=512 bytes median_alloc=4096
```

suresh: That slab_frag_pct looks high. Are we doing slab reuse per request or per model shard? We recently changed the slab expiry to 50ms (was 500ms) in the pager. Could be thrashing.

maya: Wait — we changed expiry to 50ms for the small-batch micro-optimizations. Might be killing locality for long sequences. If slabs get freed too eagerly, fused kernel warmup ends up paying allocation cost.

zara: Quick experiment I ran: bumped slab_expiry back to 300ms and forced prefault on pagehouse. Result (same bench): fused-flash-v3 132.1 ms/token, flash2 135.0 ms/token. So fused regressed mostly due to allocator churn.

alex: Nice. So two effects: 1) allocation churn increases latency before fused kernel, 2) fragmentation means GPU prefetches are split into many small memcpy calls which hurt fused kernel startup.

maya: For a fast mitigation, can we adjust kernel selection heuristic: if kv_pager.enabled && seq >= 4096 && slab_frag_pct > 20 then prefer flash2 (less sensitive to contiguous prefetch)?

zara: I tried a kernel-forcing run: forcing `kernel=flash2` removes the prefetch spikes entirely and gives 10% win over fused on that config. But on short sequences fused still wins.

alex: Agree with heuristics. Also want allocator improvements: coalescing small free chunks before returning to pagehouse, and increase small-slab target size from 64->128 to reduce fragmentation.

maya: I'll open two PRs: one for a conservative kernel-fallback heuristic and one to revert slab_expiry change + increase small-slab size default. Can you both add microbench results to PR?

zara: Will add my numbers to PR #4256. Also adding a small smoke test to perf-nightly that runs seq=8192 on a single host with kv_pager=on to catch regressions.

alex: I'll add allocator telemetry to runtime tracing so we can see slab_frag_pct in Console dashboards per-route. That'll help decide safe thresholds.

suresh: Also consider prefetch coalescing: instead of issuing N small memcpy for fragmented pages, batch contiguous ranges and issue fewer memcpy ops. That should bring fused back near baseline.

maya: Good call. We should prioritize kernel-fallback + slab expiry revert as quick rollouts, then follow with coalescing change.

perf-ci-bot: [auto] created issue 982: paged-attn allocation churn causes fused-flash regression (linked PRs: 4256, 4257).

alex: Action items: @maya PRs + perf smoke (today), @zara add bench numbers + nightly job (today), @suresh prototype coalescing patch (WIP), alex will add allocator telemetry (WIP).

zara: Quick note — when testing, also try varying page_size=32/64/128. I saw page_size=128 reduced fragmentation slightly for long seqs.

alex: ok. let's roll. If perf-nightly shows >10% regression after PRs, we auto-fallback to flash2 for paged-attn until coalescing lands. :thumbsup:

perf-ci-bot: [auto] nightly-smoke queued (seq=8192, page_size=64) - will report back in ~30m.

maya: thanks all. leaving logs in #eng-runtime artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/paged-attn/2623456789/ (bench + allocator dumps).
